title: Blue sandbox button
summary: The homepage hero Try Our Sandbox button changes from purple to blue, with a darker blue hover state. Review its appearance and sandbox entry before publishing.
source: Committed review plan for this interview demonstration.

scenarios.title: Compare the sandbox button color
scenarios.description: Only the homepage hero's Try Our Sandbox button changes color.
scenarios.instructions: Toggle Original and Changed. Compare the large Try Our Sandbox button beneath the headline.
scenarios.expected: Original is purple (#7041b8). Changed is blue (#2563eb), with white readable text and the same label, size and position.
steps: Original shows the purple hero button.
Changed shows the blue hero button with readable white text.

scenarios.title: Check hover, keyboard focus and sandbox entry
scenarios.description: The color change must preserve the existing sandbox journey.
scenarios.instructions: In Changed, hover the hero button and use Tab to focus it. Activate it and confirm sandbox entry loads. Use Reset item to return to the homepage.
scenarios.expected: Hover is darker blue (#1d4ed8), focus remains visible, and activation opens /demo.
steps: Hover and keyboard focus are clear.
The button opens the existing sandbox entry without an error.
